title: Auto load when filling the crate
problem: Filling the crate takes a tap for every piece.
scope: A button beside Open my stall that fills the crate with what is wanted: up to each fruit's wanted count, the oldest pieces a wanting customer takes, keeping what is already in the crate; greyed when nothing is left to add
exclusions: Any rule, balance, save or message change

acceptance.text: Tests: the oldest pieces a buyer takes, never more than wanted, what is in the crate stays, a second tap adds nothing; in whole games a crate the rules accept

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-13, in his own words: "include an auto load button during crate unloading which allows players to unload all wanted fruits into the crate".
